description: Every input a send needs, as questions to ask the person, with this account's options for each. kind automation: the event that starts it (tracked events with their properties, and the Mixpanel events mapped to them), filters, how long after the event to text, right away or optimal user time, the event that ends it, follow-ups, repeats, who gets it, the message, link, sender and topic. kind broadcast: audience, who to leave out, message, when, sender, topic, follow-up. Also who never gets the text (exclusions) and what is missing (gaps). Changes nothing.

kind.description: automation (texts started by an event) or broadcast (one send to an audience).
